name: What role do trial attorneys play in settlement negotiations?

mainEntity.name: What role do trial attorneys play in settlement negotiations?

acceptedAnswer.text: Trial attorneys drive settlement negotiations by leveraging trial readiness to force better terms, often resolving cases before reaching the courtroom.abtl+1​
